title: Stream Processing, Retries & DLQ
docTitle: Stream Processing, Retries & DLQ - SDE Prep Dojo
description: How the ShopStream enricher validates and prices orders with Kafka transactions (exactly-once), sends temporary failures to a retry topic with backoff, parks poison messages in a dead-letter topic, writes safely to Postgres with an idempotent upsert, and computes 1-minute revenue windows with event time and watermarks.

hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 60 min Kafka Python Postgres

Stream Processing, Retries & DLQ

The middle of a pipeline is where things go wrong. After this page you can explain, with real code, how ShopStream processes every order exactly once inside Kafka, retries without blocking, quarantines bad data, writes to a database without duplicates, and counts revenue per minute even when events arrive late.
